free_tier.stated: The API is no longer self-serve: 'The API is currently in limited release; contact our team to request access', on the Expression Measurement overview. The pricing URL no longer exists as a page: https://www.hume.ai/pricing and https://platform.hume.ai/pricing both land on the marketing home page, which now sells a voice-AI evaluation platform rather than an API. Third-party readings of the pricing page from September 2026 recorded a Free plan at '10,000 characters per month, 5 EVI minutes, 15 requests per minute, 1 concurrent connection' plus USD 20 of new-account credits.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: the interesting part of the September free tier was 10,000 characters of Octave TTS plus 5 EVI minutes on one email; with the gate now in place, the only route is to substitute ElevenLabs or Cartesia, both recorded at 10,000 and 20,000 monthly credits.

limits.value: access is granted by a sales conversation: 'contact our team to request access' means the free allowance that existed in September 2026 cannot be signed up for in October 2026, and a person with an email address has no route in without an approved application.

requesting the pricing URL returned final_url https://www.hume.ai/ with the title 'Measure and improve real-world voice AI performance'; the page sells an evaluation platform and states no prices or free tier
the platform pricing URL also returned final_url https://www.hume.ai/, the same marketing home page
'Free | billed monthly - 10,000 characters per month - 5 EVI minutes - 15 RPM', read by that site on 2026-09-20, reported and no longer reproducible from the vendor
'Free - 10,000 characters of TTS/month (Octave 1 & Octave 2) - 5 minutes of EVI included - 15 requests per minute - 1 concurrent connection', reported, corroborating the September reading

notes: These are inference credits, not general compute. The finding is the withdrawal of a self-serve free tier behind an access request, which is why the verdict is fails-identity rather than dead: Hume sells and its evaluation product is live, but the API needs an approved conversation. Data point worth carrying: the site's own benchmark page labels one model view 'Illustrative, not real data', so the leaderboard numbers on the new home page are not measurements.
